name: Aobh
text: Aobh is the modern Irish text of the old Irish name that MacKillop writes as Ahbh. The name is that of a woman in the old tales, tied to the fey of the Irish. The dictionary keeps the modern shapes as a separate line.

attributes.attribute: modern spelling of the old Irish woman's name

okr.objective: Record the modern Irish form Aobh.
key_results: Set it in the old tales.
